name: Local SEO By Ankit Rawat
author: Ankit Rawat

sections.description:
Simply place the required information and see this magic of local seo.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 (or later). See the GPL License for more details.

Version 2.0

*Business Logo & Images, Option to upload a logo and images for the business.
*Social Media Profiles Schema, Add support for linking social media profiles.
*Introduced a country_code field in settings.

Version 1.1

*Security Update.
*New Feature, Added an option to enable/disable the JSON-LD schema output.
*Plugin Cleanup, Included an uninstall hook to remove all plugin-related options upon uninstallation.
*Performance Improvements, Added strict checks before outputting JSON-LD schema to avoid unnecessary processing.
*Code Enhancements, Namespaced functions and constants with unique prefixes to prevent conflicts with other plugins.

Version 1.0

*Initial release.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Local SEO By Ankit Rawat directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the Local SEO By Ankit Rawat Menu and setup all the fields.
  4. Click the “Save” button.
sections.faq:
Will this plugin help with Local SEO?
Yes, this plugin enhances Local SEO by adding Local Schema, which helps improve your visibility and dominance in SERPs.
